description.subtitle: Scent remover spray for football boots, goalkeeper gloves and sports equipment Glove Glu 250 ml - black
description.tagline: Combate los malos olores de tu equipamiento deportivo
description.intro: Glove Glu Stop'em Smelling 250 ml spray is designed to remove the bad smells of football boots, goalkeeper gloves, bags and other sports accessories. Its organic odor control formula uses natural elements extracted from plants to act on bacteria and sweat responsible for the bad smell.
key_benefits: Control del mal olor: Ayuda a eliminar los olores generados por el sudor y el uso continuado del equipamiento deportivo.
Action on its origin: Its formula acts on bacteria and sweat responsible for the appearance of odors.
Versatile use: Can be applied to football boots, goalkeeper gloves, bags and other sports accessories.
Practical care: Its spray format facilitates a quick application inside the equipment.
Long-acting: The treatment is designed to completely remove the odor within 48 hours.
